newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse extends falling spell into new year.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse extends falling spell into new year.

text.p: The Abidjan Stock Exchange (BVA) carried over its downward trend into the new year, falling for the fifth straight week at the start of trading in 1997, its weekly report showed on Friday.
The BVA All-Share Index dipped in the week to Friday by 0.55 percent to 356.95 points from 358.94. The 12VB blue chip index dropped 0.61 percent to 241.25 points from 242.73.
But volume improved to 58.3 billion CFA francs on 2,944 shares traded compared with 36.8 billion CFA on 1,774 shares changing hands.

Diversified company Blohorn was the most actively traded stock, accounting for 13.8 billion CFA of total volume on 316 shares or 23.6 percent of shares traded. It gained 200 CFA to 40,510 CFA. ($1=525 CFA francs)
